topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: You ever notice how the rain always picks the perfect moment to start? Like it’s got a keen eye for the quiet times, the moments when the world’s just a bit too still. Found a manuscript today, tucked away in a drawer where it didn’t belong. Turns out, it’s a story all about me, written by her. Every page, every line, dripping with detail, with moments we thought were just ours, now laid out in black and white. Who knew she had it in her, to capture the way the light hits the breakfast nook, or how I hum tunes from the old days when I think no one’s listening. Not a bad read, either. Might just finish it tonight, maybe even pour us both a drink. There’s something in those words, something that feels right, like the pieces of a puzzle clicking into place without a struggle.
